purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: civic interview; vocabulary (法案/判決/議会/ボランティア/貢献) in natural home.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: ボランティア活動を、始めた理由は?
lines.en: Why did you start volunteer work?
lines.style: engaged young interviewer voice, soft warm curious focus throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 社会に貢献したい、と思ったんです。
lines.en: I wanted to contribute to society.
lines.style: warm volunteer voice, soft warm sincere clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 新しい法案は、追い風ですか?
lines.en: Is the new bill a tailwind?
lines.style: curious young interviewer voice, soft warm focus throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: ええ、法案が活動を後押しします。
lines.en: Yes, the bill boosts our activities.
lines.style: composed volunteer voice, soft warm sincere clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 議会にも、要望を伝えましたか?
lines.en: Did you convey requests to the assembly too?
lines.style: engaged young interviewer voice, soft warm focus throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 議会に、現場の声を届けました。
lines.en: We brought field voices to the assembly.
lines.style: earnest volunteer voice, soft warm sincere clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 先の判決も、励みになりましたか?
lines.en: Did the recent ruling encourage you too?
lines.style: thoughtful young interviewer voice, soft warm focus throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 判決のおかげで、貢献の輪が広がりました。
lines.en: Thanks to the ruling, our circle of contribution grew.
lines.style: warm volunteer voice, soft warm sincere closing clarity throughout
